record.dic_text:
4556 sardios {sar'-dee-os}

適當地說是源自不明字根的形容詞; 形容詞

欽定本 - sardius 1; 1

1) 一種紅色的寶石, 有兩類, 前者因其肉色澤, 故稱為"肉紅玉髓" (carnelian),
   後者稱為"肉紅石髓" (sard) (#啟21:20|)
record.edic_text:
4556 sardios {sar'-dee-os}

properly, an adjective from an uncertain base;; adj

AV - sardius 1; 1

1) a sardius, a precious stone of which there are two types, the former
   is called a carnelian (because flesh coloured) and the latter a sard

same.cexp: 紅條紋瑪瑙（瑪瑙的一種）（#啟 21:20|）
